name: quality-dev-skills
description: 质量与治理全家桶——6 个技能（流程级质量门禁/PRD 1:1 解析/技能优化/初始化引导/两个垂直包）+ governance 代码门禁运行时（PostToolUse 声明式规则引擎/验证机器凭证/哈希链事件流/完整性自保护）+ 3 个中立 agent 模板。整仓即插件、天然自包含。

description_i18n.en: Quality & governance bundle — 6 skills (process-level quality gating, lossless PRD parsing, skill optimizer, init wizard, two vertical packs) plus the governance code-gating runtime (declarative PostToolUse rule engine, verification machine receipts, hash-chained event stream, integrity self-check) and 3 neutral agent templates. The whole repo IS the plugin: self-contained by design.
